Bangladesh garment sector lost $428 million amid unrest

The ready-made garment sector in Bangladesh incurred production losses of $428 million over 18 days of unrest, according to a preliminary industry survey. Additionally, buyers shifted orders valued at $254 million to competing nations. The garment makers are considering a 15% wage increase, which falls short of the workers' demands. The unrest also saw clashes between supporters of the BNP and Awami League.
